scope: offline teacher-imitation replay, not closed-loop task success or routing authorization

tool_family_choice.teacher: historical agent first-tool-family majority, backend unknown, weak behavioral proxy

split: Original task groups, with identical decision-input groups unioned before seed-stable 50/20/30 pool/dev/test assignment. Few-shot labels come only from pool.
budget_unit: UTF8 evidence bytes, a conservative token ceiling for byte-level Qwen tokenizers. Wrapper and original task tokens are outside the evidence budget. Actual full prompt tokens come from llama.cpp /tokenize.
few_shot_selection: Two same-family lexical Jaccard neighbors from the pool, stable row-ID tie break. Examples contain compact predecision summary, available option IDs and pool teacher choice.
selection: Pick maximum dev agreement, then lower dev p50 latency. Never select a variant using test labels.
uncertainty: 2000 paired task-cluster bootstrap samples, seed1729. Exploratory intervals have no multiple-comparison correction. Zero-error nonparametric intervals can be degenerate.
calibration: Ten-bin ECE on chosen-option probability and multiclass Brier score against teacher. Grammar-conditional option probabilities are not calibrated correctness estimates.

additional_parent_requested_policies.timing: Requested after frozen model replay began. No new labels, prompts, or model calls.
additional_parent_requested_policies.knn_only: Same retriever, majority vote for k in 1,3,5. Select k by maximum dev accuracy, ties smaller k. Tied label vote counts choose nearest supporting neighbor, similarity ties use stable row IDs.
additional_parent_requested_policies.option_scoring: Already the frozen model readout: argmax actual single-token slot probabilities. No free-text parsing arm or fresh inference is necessary.
additional_parent_requested_policies.cascade: Thresholds are dev margin quantiles plus zero and explicit all-escalate. Select maximum dev coverage with at least ten answers and at least95% answered accuracy. Otherwise escalate all.
additional_parent_requested_policies.cascade_claim: Test answered accuracy and escalation curve only. Escalation uses counterfactual recorded-teacher answers, not measured fresh Jev calls.
additional_parent_requested_policies.majority_comparison: Compare all arms to training-majority choices within each exact available-option vocabulary.

missing_injection_evidence.memory: Two explicitly granted z0int-memory searches returned empty packets
missing_injection_evidence.skill_relevance: No replayable historical skill prompt and roster pairs

private_data_policy: Do not commit raw session requests, frozen prompts, few-shot passages or raw model responses. Retain these under the operations evidence directory. Public report contains aggregates and digests only.
